en:
Shuichi! Is it true that you've found another
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?
Yes, it's true.

Wait, so Kokichi *wasn't* lying!
I'm stunned! Startled! Shocked!

See? I told you I wasn't lying. Good thing too,
cuz I don't want my pants on fire.

I want to start talking about what we're 
going to do, but Kaito isn't here yet...
Maki's not here either!
Oh, Maki's not coming. I didn't invite her.
Huh? You didn't invite her?

Forget about that killer. Hey Miu, Kee-boy, did
you guys see the computer room on the 4th floor?
Computer room, you say? Go onnnn...

Yeah, there was a big computer on the 4th
floor. Would you take a look later?

You or Keebo might know something
about it, right?
I'm sorry. I'm not very computer savvy.
O-Oh... Is that so...? That's...unexpected.

I have been meaning to ask, but...
Keebo, what *is* your talent, exactly?
Well...I can do all sorts of things.

Oh yes! I'm pretty good at one-man comedy
shows, if I do say so myself!

Kee-boy's existence is the only <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> thing
about him. Other than that, he's got no talent.

I just told you I'm good at one-man comedy
shows!

I don't really get it, but we just need to check
out this computer room, right?

But I'm not gonna come just for some computer.
It's gonna take way more than that!

Ah, well...
The Monokubs did say it was amazing...
Hey! Thanks for waiting!
K-Kaito! And...
M-Maki!? Why is Maki with you!?

Well, this is about that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
so everyone should be here, yeah?

But...when you say <CLT=cltSTRONG>"everyone"<CLT=cltNORMAL> do you 
truly need to include a professional killer?
...I'm leaving.
Wait, hold on a sec.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito gripped Maki's arm before
she could leave.

Kaito, didn't you say you wanted to take
down her mask or whatever?

Yeah, I'm gonna take down 
her mask as a <CLT=cltSTRONG>murderer<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...What?

I just can't believe a girl like her is capable
of killing people in cold blood..

Um... Is it true? Are you really the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Maki?
Have you...killed anyone before?
...Yes.
<CLT=cltMIND>Really...?
Why...you hide that?

Pfft! Isn't it obvious!? It's so she could kill us
all before we figured out her identity!

You're wrong... It's because I knew you guys
would react this way.
...What?

When people learn my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent, they get
the same fear in their eyes that you all have...
Eventually...that fear will turn into hate.

And then someone will try to kill me because
they're afraid I'll kill them first.
That's not—

Whenever someone learns my real identity, they
try to kill me. It happens every time. Always.
...A-Always?
Hmm... You've lived a pretty sad life, Maki.

Oh...poor, poor Maki. I feel so sorry for you.
I think I'm about to cry...

Because of everything you've been through,
human life has no value to you now, is that it!?
She's an assassin, not some murderous fiend!

Even if she did kill someone, that doesn't 
mean she thinks it's okay to—
Hey, can you let go of me now?
Hm? O-Oh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito finally let go of her arm,
and Maki let out a sigh.
I knew you wouldn't believe me...

That's why I kept it a secret...and tried
to avoid you guys as much as I could.

But someone who doesn't know how to
mind his business kept dragging me places.
Huh? Are you talking about me?
However, I'll say this...

I have no intention of killing any of you...
unless one of you tries to kill me first.

Having said that...you probably won't
believe me anyway.

So...you guys mind your business, I'll mind
mine, and we'll all agree to avoid each other.
Please...just pretend I'm not even here.
Maki...

<CLT=cltMIND>It started out as a threat, but the last
bit...seemed a little sad.

Geez, Kaito. What were you thinking?
Are you trying to turn us against each other?

I think I speak for everyone when I say, we're
all disappointed in you! Right, guys!?
N-No... I wouldn't say that, but...

Shall we finally get started? We've all gathered
here for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, yes?

Yes... So, have we all decided what we're
going to do?

Use it, of course! We might be able to
remember something new!
Like the true purpose of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Well...we don't know for sure if it's got
anything to do with why we're trapped here...

Don't gimme that wishy-washy bullshit! 
Of course it's got something to do with why!

Hey, instead of arguing, it'd be way faster to
just use it, y'know?
Yeah... Gonta worry, but we gotta do it.

But but, no matter what we remember, you
can't think about wanting to leave this place.
If you think like that...
We'll just be repeating ourselves.

I-I know that! And we can't go around
repeating ourselves!

Then let's give it a try.
Shuichi, go for it.

Umm, I'm a little nervous...
I'm sort of...just plain nauseous.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone turned their eyes to me,
and I flicked on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>And at that moment, once again...
<CLT=cltMIND>The world...
<CLT=cltMIND>...warped.

<CLT=cltMIND>My consciousness went white, and somewhere
in that whiteness, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>scene<CLT=cltMIND> played.

They were so young and talented...
How could this happen?

It looked like...an accident. 
They were running away from <CLT=cltSTRONG>that group<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

...Was it really just an accident though?
I honestly can't believe that.
Ah!
<CLT=cltMIND>What...was that?
<CLT=cltMIND>A funeral?
<CLT=cltMIND>It...was mine...
<CLT=cltMIND>It was everyone's here!

Wh-Why? Why was I...
at my own funeral?
What!? A funeral... You, too, Shuichi!?

It would appear we all remembered 
the same thing.
But what the fuck does it mean!?

Why was I watching your guys' funeral!?
A-And...why was I there, too!?

Wh-What the hell is goin' on!?
What was the funeral...?

But...the only thing I can remember is seeing
that funeral. Nothing else...
Maybe we...already dead!?

Ahahahahahaha!
No way!

Geez...this is so stupid, I couldn't help 
but laugh.

I mean...there's no way that was our 
memory of our funeral...
Then what was it?

It was probably...a memory of our school 
festival or something.
School festival?

Yeah, it was probably a memory from a play 
we did for the school festival or something.

I mean, isn't it obvious if you just 
think about it?

If that funeral was real, there's no way 
we'd still be alive!
Nyeeeh...that's true.

But aren't we all from different high schools?
Why would we have a school festival together?

Th-That's...we'll probably remember 
something else about it later.

Anyway, there's no way that funeral was real!
There's no mistaking that!

You're right... If we think about it logically,
that's clearly out of the question...

Okay...good. Gonta think everyone was
already dead.

Stop saying stupid stuff! Look at me, 
I'm alive! Hale and hearty!

Hardy? Cuz you get a hard-on every time
you see me?

Oh, I heard males can tell they're healthy by
how hard they get in the morning! Is that true!?
Hey! St-Stay in your lane, bitch!
I'm not good with other people's dirty jokes...
Aw maaan, what a disappointment...
A disappointment?

Nyeeeh...it's true. This <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> was 
a real letdown...

We didn't find out anything about the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>. Just some weird memory.
Yeah, seriously. Talk about a disappointment...

No, I'm not talking about the memory.
I'm talking about you guys...
What...?

Oh, no! It's nothing! I'm just lying again,
so don't worry about it!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish you wouldn't have said
anything in the first place...

<CLT=cltMIND>But more importantly, the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>memory of the funeral<CLT=cltMIND> we saw...
<CLT=cltMIND>It can't be a memory of a real funeral...
<CLT=cltMIND>We have to learn more about this...

<CLT=cltMIND>No matter how hard I think about it,
I can't wrap my head around it.

<CLT=cltMIND>After that experience, we ate a meal in
the dining hall and returned to our rooms.
